{{Quote|Limpet mine. Perfect for planting a tracer.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]|<ref name="YJK" />}}
'''Limpet mines''' were a type of shaped directional explosive.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==Characteristics==
Limpet mines were small disc-shaped explosives designed to take out tanks, heavy vehicles, fortifications, and other armored surfaces.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /><ref name="YJK" /> One side of the mine was coated with microbeads of adhesive that activated on hard contact with a flat surface (such as the side of a tank), ensuring solid adhesion of the mine to its target. On activation, the mine detonated in a one meter burst; because of its shaped charge, the mine did negligible damage outside of this burst, directing its explosive energy towards the surface it was attached to.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==History==
Limpet mines were used by the [[Poss'Nomin]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Reginald Barkbone]] and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]].
